page0.text:
Tohsaka's closer to the Shadow than I am.
Archer's on his last legs, and Tohsaka's too shocked by his injuries to move.
That means I'm the only one who can bring her back here...!

page1.text:
"Tohsaka!"
I let go of Illya's hand and run to Tohsaka.
I can still make it.
I'm about five meters from Tohsaka, and the Shadow is another ten meters away. If I run as fast as I can, grab her hand and jump to the side, I can—

page2.text: I was wrong to think I could change anything.

page3.text:
The swollen Shadow burst in an instant.
I couldn't even grab Tohsaka's hand.
In a heartbeat, the Shadow overruns the forest,
swallowing every last prey within its web.

page4.text:
My body temperature rises.
A lethal jungle fever destroys my body.
There's no vaccine against it,
and even if I try to escape the heat...
...my mind dies before my body.

page5.text:
My soulless body is swallowed.
As I melt into the Shadow...
